context: Renewal discussion for the Denver campus chiller plant.

attendees.name: Priya Nair
attendees.title: Facilities Director
attendees.body: Signs the renewal and raised the pricing concern on Sep 24.

what_you_need_to_know.body: Priya rejected the 3-year price on Sep 24.

objective: Agree a revised 3-year price and a signing date.
questions: What number makes the 3-year term work for Acme's budget cycle?
Who else must approve before Oct 15?
Which chiller is the biggest outage risk this winter?
Is the Oct 15 date tied to a budget freeze?

risks.body: A competitor quote may already be on Priya's desk.

actions.body: Send the revised quote before the call
